title: Payment API - Database Connection Pool Exhaustion SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Check database connection pool metrics via CloudWatch or Grafana (HikariCP/PgBouncer active vs idle connections).
2. Inspect database active connections: SELECT count(*), state FROM pg_stat_activity GROUP BY state;
3. Check if recent deployments modified max_connections, connectionTimeout, or idleTimeout in application.yml or Helm values.
4. If active connections equals max_pool_size, temporarily scale connection pool size or inspect long-running unindexed transactions.
5. Restart application pods with increased pool configuration if approved.

title: Payment API - Third-Party Payment Gateway Timeout SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Verify third-party status page for Stripe/Adyen outages.
2. Inspect circuit breaker metrics: payment_gateway_circuit_breaker_state.
3. Verify egress NAT gateway bandwidth and packet drop metrics.
4. Switch primary processor to fallback processor if degradation exceeds 5 minutes.

title: Authentication Service - JWT Token Validation Failure SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Verify JWKS endpoint reachable: curl -s https://auth.internal.corp/.well-known/jwks.json.
2. Inspect secret manager for recent key rotations or missing public keys.
3. Check pod environment variables: JWT_SIGNING_KEY_ID and JWT_PUBLIC_KEY.
4. Rollback deployment if key rotation occurred without dual-key tolerance window.

title: Redis Cache - Out Of Memory (OOM) & Eviction Storm SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Run redis-cli INFO memory to verify used_memory vs maxmemory.
2. Inspect maxmemory-policy (volatile-lru, allkeys-lru, or noeviction).
3. Check top memory-consuming keys with redis-cli --bigkeys or MEMORY USAGE.
4. If memory exhausted due to missing TTLs, apply emergency TTL script or scale Redis cluster node memory.

title: Message Queue - Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance Loop SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Check consumer group lag: kafka-consumer-groups.sh --describe --group payment-processor-group.
2. Check max.poll.interval.ms vs message processing time in worker logs.
3. If downstream processing exceeds timeout, increase max.poll.interval.ms or decrease max.poll.records.
4. Restart stuck consumer pods sequentially to stabilize rebalance.

title: API Gateway - Cascading Circuit Breaker & 502/504 SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Inspect Envoy / NGINX access logs for upstream service breakdown.
2. Check endpoint health checks: curl -I http://upstream-service:8080/health.
3. Verify Kubernetes Service endpoints: kubectl get endpoints <service-name>.
4. Temporarily raise circuit breaker failure rate threshold if false positive trips occur during traffic spike.

title: Order Service - Database Lock Contention SOP
Notification Service - Rate Limit Throttling SOP
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Check provider quota dashboards (Amazon SES / Twilio / SendGrid).
2. Enable exponential backoff in notification queue consumer.
3. Request temporary quota increase from vendor or route non-critical notifications to delayed queue.
